<documents>
<document id="security-password-reset">
ResettingˆyourˆpasswordˆIfˆyouˆforgotˆyourˆpassword,ˆyouˆcanˆresetˆitˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ##ˆResetˆyourˆpasswordˆ1.ˆTapˆForgotˆpasswordˆonˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆemailˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆaˆresetˆlink.ˆ3.ˆOpenˆtheˆlinkˆonˆtheˆsameˆphone,ˆconfirmˆtheˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆtextˆyou,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆnewˆpassword.ˆTheˆlinkˆexpiresˆafterˆanˆhour.ˆIfˆitˆhasˆexpired,ˆstartˆagain.ˆ##ˆDidn'tˆgetˆtheˆemail?ˆCheckˆspamˆandˆmakeˆsureˆyouˆenteredˆtheˆemailˆyouˆsignedˆupˆwith.ˆIfˆyouˆnoˆlongerˆhaveˆaccessˆtoˆthatˆemail,ˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆForˆyourˆsecurity,ˆchangingˆtheˆemailˆonˆanˆaccountˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆinˆtoˆneedsˆextraˆchecks.ˆ##ˆAfterˆaˆresetˆOtherˆdevicesˆareˆsignedˆout.ˆTheˆfirstˆtimeˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500ˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆIfˆyouˆdidn'tˆaskˆforˆaˆresetˆemail,ˆsomeoneˆmayˆhaveˆtypedˆyourˆemailˆbyˆmistake.ˆIfˆyouˆalsoˆseeˆaˆsign-inˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize,ˆseeˆ"Ifˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccount".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-two-step">
Two-stepˆverificationˆTwo-stepˆverificationˆisˆalwaysˆonˆforˆTallowbrookˆaccounts.ˆWhenˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆorˆdoˆsomethingˆsensitive,ˆweˆaskˆforˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆaˆsecondˆstep.ˆ##ˆTheˆsecondˆstepˆ-ˆAˆpushˆapprovalˆonˆaˆdeviceˆyou'veˆalreadyˆsignedˆinˆon,ˆorˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆsentˆbyˆtext,ˆvalidˆforˆ10ˆminutesˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆaskˆ-ˆSigningˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆ-ˆChangingˆyourˆpassword,ˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆ-ˆAddingˆaˆnewˆexternalˆaccountˆorˆwireˆrecipientˆ-ˆViewingˆyourˆfullˆvirtualˆcardˆnumberˆ##ˆKeepˆcodesˆtoˆyourselfˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆisˆonlyˆforˆyouˆtoˆtypeˆintoˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆNobodyˆfromˆTallowbrookˆwillˆaskˆyouˆtoˆreadˆitˆout.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasks,ˆit'sˆaˆscam.ˆ##ˆChangedˆyourˆphoneˆnumber?ˆUpdateˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆwhileˆyouˆstillˆhaveˆtheˆoldˆnumber.ˆIfˆyou'veˆlostˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆoldˆnumber,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆpassˆitˆtoˆtheˆteamˆthatˆverifiesˆidentity,ˆwhichˆcanˆtakeˆlonger.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="direct-deposit-setup">
SettingˆupˆdirectˆdepositˆDirectˆdepositˆsendsˆyourˆpaycheck,ˆorˆbenefits,ˆstraightˆintoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆ##ˆSetˆitˆupˆ-ˆ**Automatic:**ˆtapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDirectˆdeposit,ˆthenˆSetˆupˆautomatically.ˆFindˆyourˆemployerˆorˆpayrollˆproviderˆandˆsignˆin.ˆTheˆswitchˆhappensˆinˆtheˆpayrollˆsystem.ˆ-ˆ**Manual:**ˆdownloadˆaˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆfromˆtheˆsameˆscreen,ˆorˆcopyˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber,ˆandˆgiveˆitˆtoˆyourˆemployer.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆEmployersˆusuallyˆneedˆoneˆorˆtwoˆpayˆcyclesˆtoˆmakeˆtheˆswitch.ˆYourˆfirstˆpaycheckˆmayˆstillˆgoˆtoˆyourˆoldˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhelpsˆ-ˆYouˆmayˆgetˆpaidˆupˆtoˆ2ˆdaysˆearly.ˆ-ˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdaysˆtoˆuseˆCushion.ˆ##ˆSplittingˆaˆpaycheckˆYourˆemployerˆmayˆletˆyouˆsplitˆyourˆpayˆbetweenˆaccounts.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆsetˆupˆanˆautomaticˆtransferˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆtoˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆonˆpayday.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: How long is the one-time sign in code good for?
